comment: Great instructor, She gave good feedback and graded assignments in a timely fashion. I also like that she opened up the course for you to work ahead if you'd like. Although, it sometimes felt like there was a lot to do in a short amount of time. I think the coursework really is preparing me for knowledge management 2.

Professor Wittig is the sweetest. She is very caring and always willing to meet with you outside of class, wanting her students to do well, and giving very helpful advice with essays/assignments. She is very organized with her material. Even though the work was a lot and I think too much, if you put in effort you should get a good grade.

Carol is the best professor I meet at UR. She is patient and structured, and assigns clear assignment and gives structured classes. She is an effort based easy grader, and she let us discuss freely in class. I definitely want to take her class again.
She is a tough grader and gives out multiple lengthy papers with little to no time in between

Dr. Wittig is pretty awesome. Her FYS is taught very well and is structured on a variety of topics that she feels are helpful. If you've taken AP Lang, it's just like a well-taught version of it with some more college stuff. Participation really matters. Expect to read quite a bit and write a bit, but she's a very nice grader (and is really nice).
She is probably the best professor this semester. There is a quite a bit to do outside of class compared to the other FYS' but it is manageable. Very easy and accessible outside of class. Take her

Professor Wittig is generally easy because she is accessible outside of class and doesn't intend for her weekly assignments to be too difficult. I would definitely recommend taking for an FYS if it's an option.

Carol is VERY knowledgable in what she does. I love the fact she interacts alot with her students and challenges your thinking.  Her technique for research has really made it easier and help me to understand how to write a research paper. Thanks Carol!! you're the best.

She's super nice, helpful and knowledgable though somewhat disorganized and can be unclear in directions.  Is connected and tech savvy.  Will answer emails at all hours within minutes.  Encourages surfing in class.

Very nice and helpful!  Our textbook was new and hard to get so we didn't really use it!  I took her for a 7-week course (Knowledge Management).  Lot of work, but great introduction into what is expected of the Weekend College program!
She is a doll. I love her. She is the best professor. Just go to class, if you dont understand tell her. She explains everything. She is patient.
